name: com.playtradex.sdk
description:
PlayTradeX SDK 0.4.0-alpha introduces RPC load balancing for Unity blockchain applications.

• Round robin request distribution across configured healthy RPC endpoints
• Health aware endpoint selection with automatic cooldown and recovery
• Concurrent request distribution across available RPC endpoints
• Automatic failover with load balancer cursor correction
• Independent load balancing state for separate RPC endpoint pools

samples.description:
PlayTradeX SDK 0.4.0-alpha integration sample for Unity.

• RPC load balancing across configured endpoints
• Round robin RPC request distribution
• Automatic failover and endpoint recovery
• Concurrent RPC execution
• Network operations using load balanced RPC pools
